doc_kind: Medicare Advantage medical coverage policy (BlueCHiP for Medicare)
lines_of_business: BlueCHiP for Medicare only; commercial refers to Preauthorization via Web-Based Tool
criteria_location: Medical Criteria (p.1) for indications; Policy Statement (p.1-2) for contraindications and chronic-pain exclusion; Background defines 'recent' fracture.

logic.top_level: any (list of indications) plus a NOT list of absolute contraindications and relative contraindications

k_of_n.quote: Percutaneous vertebroplasty is medically necessary when one of the following criteria are met

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate absolute contraindication list (coagulopathy or anticoagulation, allergy, infection, retropulsed fragments with canal compromise, tumor canal compromise with myelopathy) and relative lists per procedure.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: persistent debilitating pain that has not responded to accepted standard medical treatment;* and/or
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' between list items on the kyphoplasty list, while heading says 'one of'; asterisk with no footnote

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Reinforcement, or stabilization, of vertebral body prior to surgery.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Preceding item ends with 'and' while list heading says 'one of'

requirement_kinds.quote: An osteoporotic or osteopenic compression fracture of the lumbar or thoracic vertebrae
has not responded to accepted standard medical treatment generally within six (6) weeks to three months
Painful and/or aggressive vertebral hemangiomas (or eosinophilic granulomas of the spine)
Painful vertebral fracture associated with osteonecrosis (Kummell Disease)
any existing uncorrected coagulopathy or anticoagulation therapy
vertebra reduced to less than one-third [1/3] of its original height
A 'recent' compression fracture ... demonstrates uptake on a bone scan or exhibits increased intensity on fluid-sensitive MRI sequences

thresholds.quote: generally within six (6) weeks to three months

time_windows.quote: generally within six (6) weeks to three months

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT 22510-22515 'covered when the medical criteria is met'; add-on codes covered if the primary is approved

external_dependencies.quote: For commercial products, please refer to the following policy: Preauthorization via Web-Based Tool for Procedures
Local Coverage Determination (LCD): Vertebroplasty and Vertebral Augmentation (Percutaneous) (L33569)

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: one which demonstrates uptake on a bone scan or exhibits increased intensity on fluid-sensitive MRI sequences
Vertebral compression fractures due to osteoporosis are considered pathologic fractures.

vague_terms.quote: accepted standard medical treatment generally within six (6) weeks to three months

vague_terms.problem: Relative means case judgment, not a hard NOT

vague_terms.quote: chronic back pain of long-standing duration ... unless pain is localized to a specific chronic fracture and medical therapy has failed

extraction_hazards: Bullets as glyph characters; list items end in ';' 'and' or 'and/or'
Asterisk after 'standard medical treatment;*' has no matching footnote
Criteria spread over Medical Criteria and Policy Statement; Policy Statement says 'when the above criteria are met'
interesting_structures: Absolute vs relative contraindications split by procedure

fit_to_tree.why: Any-of indications plus a NOT list work, but relative contraindications are judgment, and/or conflicts in the lists.
